capabilities.reason: Unity Catalog is the governance plane; older workspaces may still default to hive_metastore.
limitations: UC requires a metastore assignment per region; hive_metastore remains for legacy tables.

capabilities.reason: Serverless compute for notebooks/jobs is available on premium+ tiers and DBR-serverless runtimes.
limitations: Serverless warehouses/jobs are tier-gated; all-purpose clusters are not serverless.

capabilities.reason: Lakeflow (DLT) pipelines run streaming/batch declarative flows; continuous vs triggered is a mode choice.
limitations: Pipelines require Delta output; not all sinks are supported.

capabilities.reason: SQL warehouses serve BI/SQL workloads; serverless warehouses minimize cold start.
limitations: Classic warehouses cold-start; serverless is tier-gated.

capabilities.reason: Databricks Asset Bundles (databricks.yml) are the IaC deployment primitive for jobs/pipelines.
limitations: Bundles deploy to a named target; local and remote state diverge without CI.
